 Follow Alex Cooper and Matt Kaplan Welcome Their First Child—and Reveal the Baby’s Gender
 The couple has been married since 2024.
 Ashleigh Carter Tue, October 20, 2026 at 1:44 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Alex Cooper and Matt Kaplan attend Netflix's XO, Kitty Los Angeles Premiere at Netflix Tudum Theater on May 11, 2023 in Los Angeles, California.
Credit: Getty Images The Gist
 Alex Cooper and her husband, Matt Kaplan, shared they welcomed their first child together on October 20.
 The "Call Her Daddy" host announced the news on her Instagram.
 Cooper and Kaplan have been married since 2024.
 Alex Cooper, 32, and Matt Kaplan, 42, are officially parents!
 On October 20, the "Call Her Daddy" host shared the happy news on Instagram: She posted a photo of her newborn wearing a cozy sweater, with a simple "💙" as the caption, suggesting the couple welcomed a baby boy.
 The couple announced they were expecting their first child together on May 17 with a sweet Instagram post. In the two photos shared on Cooper's Instagram, the podcast star can be seen sitting on the edge of a chair that Kaplan sat in. She was gazing at him and smiling while wearing a white crop top and pants. Cooper held her hand on her growing belly as Kaplan beamed at her.
 Matt Kaplan and Alex Cooper attend the 83rd annual Golden Globe Awards at The Beverly Hilton on January 11, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 She captioned the post, "Our family 🤍."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cooper has shared her pregnancy journey on social media, giving bump updates and telling fans that she had been diagnosed with gestational diabetes . The condition occurs only during pregnancy when the placenta causes insulin resistance and temporary high blood sugar. She's also shared many bump photos, often wearing cropped shirts to showcase her growing belly.
 Alex Cooper and Matt Kaplan arrive 'Prelude To The Olympics' at Fondation Louis Vuitton on July 25, 2024 in Paris, France. 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 Cooper and Kaplan first started dating in 2020 after they met each other over a Zoom meeting. The host referred to him as "Mr. Sexy Zoom Man" for a while, concealing his identity, until they became engaged in 2023.
 They married on April 6, 2024, in Riviera Maya, Mexico, at Playa Riveria, amongst family and friends. Kaplan later said the couple wasn't "looking to have a formal wedding."
 "We wanted it to feel relaxed and authentic to us and the location, so from the decor to the festivities it all was very naturally curated," he said.
 Advertisement Advertisement "It was everything we wanted it to be," Cooper told Vogue . "It was emotional, heartfelt, and we tailored it to exactly how we always envisioned it.
 Kaplan had worked as a Hollywood producer for years before becoming CEO of Ace Entertainment. He and Cooper also launched their own media company, The Unwell Network.
